description: Runs a real race on the server in a throw-away sandbox, then draws every thread. Nothing touches real accounts; the sandbox is deleted afterwards.

modeHint.SAFE: Each buyer runs UPDATE … SET remaining = remaining - 1 WHERE remaining > 0. The database does the check and the change in one step, so only the stock can be sold.
modeHint.UNSAFE: Each buyer reads the stock, waits a moment, then writes stock - 1. Everyone reads the same number before anyone writes, so many buyers "win" the same voucher.

timeline.title: Thread timeline (each bar = one thread, from start to finish)

voucher.intro: N buyers press Buy at exactly the same moment for a voucher with limited stock.
voucher.safeBody: {{winners}} buyer(s) got a voucher and {{losers}} got 409 Sold out. Stock never went below zero.
voucher.oversoldBody: {{winners}} buyers were told they got a voucher, but only {{stock}} existed. This is the lost-update bug the atomic update prevents.

payout.intro: A merchant pays N people at once. A pool of 5 threads processes the items in parallel, and each item locks the merchant's wallet.
payout.resultBody: {{paid}} paid and {{failed}} failed for lack of balance, on {{threads}} threads in {{duration}} ms.

replay.title: Replay of the real threads (slowed down)
